title: 中文維基百科有聲條目
author: 維基百科社群
description: The opening paragraph of the Chinese Wikipedia article on Haishan Fishing Port, a working harbour of fishing rafts and sampans on the Hsinchu coast of Taiwan, read aloud by the Taiwanese volunteer who wrote the article.
levelReason: A third of the passage is silence — 33 pauses totalling 27.6 s of its 83.5 s — so each clause lands before the next one starts. The speed is not what makes this Intermediate; the vocabulary is: harbour and inshore-fishing terms arrive one per sentence with no repetition, and the last two lines are a list of six fish
learningGoal: Follow a Taiwanese reference article read at teaching pace, and learn the frame Chinese uses to put a place on the map: 位於 for the address, 西臨 for what it faces, and a compass direction with a distance for everything nearby.

transcript.text: 海山漁港，
位於新竹市香山區海山里西濱公路旁，
西臨台灣海峽，
北距新竹漁港11.5公里，
東北至新竹市區8公里，
屬於第二類漁港，
目前泊地面積約4公頃，
可供350艘以上的漁筏停泊、
港區配合產業道路佈置，
主要提供平時即季風期漁筏、
舢舨停靠，
颱風時仍須拖曳上岸或駛往鄰近的新竹漁港避風。
為僅次於新竹漁港之新竹市沿海第二個專業漁港。
該港船隻多經營沿岸定置網、刺網、一支釣等漁業或於沿岸插蚵、淺海養殖，
一般均為當日往返。
漁獲物以烏魚、鯛、烏賊、白帶魚、鰆魚
以及鯊魚類等為主。

vocabulary.meaning: Is located at. The standard opening move of a Chinese reference article about a place — it comes before the address, not after it.
vocabulary.example: 位於新竹市香山區海山里西濱公路旁，

vocabulary.meaning: Borders on the west. 臨 is to face or adjoin; put any compass direction in front of it to say which side something faces.
Anchorage — the sheltered water inside a harbour where boats moor. Measured in hectares, as here, rather than in berths.
A fishing raft: the small flat craft Taiwanese crews use close to shore. Smaller than a trawler, and counted in hundreds at a harbour this size.
vocabulary.example: 可供350艘以上的漁筏停泊、

vocabulary.meaning: To pull in and moor. Used of a boat at a harbour and, just as commonly, of a train calling at a station.

options: On the Hsinchu coast, facing the Taiwan Strait
On Taiwan's east coast, facing the Pacific
On an offshore island in the Taiwan Strait

questions.prompt: What kind of boats does it mainly serve?
options: Deep-sea trawlers that stay out for weeks
Small fishing rafts and sampans working close to shore
Container ships and car ferries

questions.prompt: What happens to the boats when a typhoon comes?
options: They shelter behind the breakwater inside the harbour
They are hauled ashore or moved to nearby Hsinchu Fishing Harbour
They put out to sea to ride out the storm

title: 中文維基百科有聲條目
author: 維基百科社群
description: The opening of the Chinese Wikipedia article on 鄧福如 (A-Fu), a Taiwanese singer-songwriter, read aloud for the spoken-articles project. Seventy seconds of encyclopedic prose about a pop career: a university band, a record label, a YouTube breakout and a Golden Melody nomination.
levelReason: Fast, and almost unbroken. 204 characters in 71.3 seconds is ≈172 cpm, a fifth quicker than the other spoken-article episode here, and the reader barely stops: at a −40 dB threshold there are 3 pauses totalling 1.15 s, 1.6% of the file, against 33% for 海山漁港. The recording carries an audible room floor near −40 dB, so the count moves with the threshold — at −30 dB it is 7 pauses and 4.69 s. Either way there is no gap to think in, and the vocabulary is the music industry's
learningGoal: Follow a fast, unbroken encyclopedia paragraph about a pop career, and pick up the Taiwanese music-business vocabulary that carries it: 旗下 for who a singer records for, 出道 for the start of a career, 爆紅 for going viral, and 入圍 for being shortlisted rather than winning.

transcript.text: 鄧福如，出生於1987年6月20日，
台灣新竹市人、
華語流行音樂女歌手、
已解散樂團LazyBomb主唱，
現為豐華唱片旗下歌手，
經紀公司為新視麗娛樂創作。
鄧福如個人發行了三張錄音室專輯
及一張迷你專輯（EP），
也曾在台灣和香港舉辦個人售票演唱會。
擁有清亮嗓音的鄧福如，
演唱的歌曲多為節奏藍調及輕電子音樂，
又有多首搖滾抒情和民俗小調的中國風作品。
鄧福如出道前，曾上載多支翻唱及創作作品至YouTube，
吸引逾百萬的點擊率而網路爆紅。
成為正式歌手後，
憑在2011年首張推出的專輯
《原來如此!!》入圍第23屆金曲獎最佳新人獎。

vocabulary.meaning: To debut — to begin a professional career in entertainment. Chinese pop writing organises a whole career around the word: 出道前 is everything that came before, 出道後 everything after.
vocabulary.example: 鄧福如出道前，曾上載多支翻唱及創作作品至YouTube，

vocabulary.meaning: Under the banner of — the phrase for who an artist is signed to. 豐華唱片旗下歌手 is a singer on the Forward Music label. It works for companies and teams as readily as for record labels.
vocabulary.example: 現為豐華唱片旗下歌手，

vocabulary.meaning: R&B. This is the Taiwanese term; mainland writing says 節奏布魯斯 for the same music, and the article carries a conversion rule holding both, because it has to serve readers of each.
vocabulary.example: 演唱的歌曲多為節奏藍調及輕電子音樂，

vocabulary.meaning: To blow up — to become suddenly and hugely popular. 爆 is to explode, 紅 is to be famous, and the compound is almost always about the internet.
vocabulary.example: 吸引逾百萬的點擊率而網路爆紅。

vocabulary.meaning: To be shortlisted or nominated. Not to win: 得獎 is winning, and Chinese entertainment writing keeps the two strictly apart.
vocabulary.example: 《原來如此!!》入圍第23屆金曲獎最佳新人獎。

questions.prompt: What did Deng Fu-ru do before she was signed?
options: Posted covers and her own songs on YouTube
Won a televised singing contest
Studied music in Japan
The band she sang in at university
Her first album, and a Best New Artist nomination
A concert she held in Hong Kong

questions.prompt: What kind of music does the passage say she mostly sings?
options: Traditional folk opera
Rock ballads and nothing else
R&B and light electronic

title: 中文維基百科有聲條目
author: 維基百科社群
description: The 生平 section of the Chinese Wikipedia article on 吳宗憲 — the dizi and xiao player who co-founded the Chinese chamber ensemble 采風樂坊, not the television host of the same name. A whole career in one section: school, a competition in South Africa, an ensemble, a state arts grant and a prize.
levelReason: 215 characters in 74.6 seconds is ≈173 cpm, as fast as the other Mandarin episode here, but this reader leaves room: 14 pauses totalling 8.75 s at −40 dB, 12% of the file, and they fall on the semicolons. What makes it Advanced is the proper nouns — 文建會, 介壽館, 資深青商總會, 十大傑出青年薪傳獎 arrive with no explanation, and they are Taiwanese institutions there is no way to infer
learningGoal: Follow a Taiwanese biography read at news pace, and learn the frame a Chinese CV is built on: 就學 for where you were at school, 畢業於 for where you graduated, 獲 for what you were awarded — and 國樂, the Taiwanese name for the tradition the whole passage is about.

transcript.text: 吳宗憲是臺灣省花蓮縣人，
小學四年級時開始學鋼琴、參加合唱團；
在板橋高中就學時加入國樂社，
開始學習中國笛；
大學畢業於中國文化大學音樂系國樂組。
1983年，吳宗憲到南非參加第二屆世界青年才藝大賽，
獲器樂獨奏項目比賽第三獎。
1991年與二胡演奏家黃正銘
共創「采風樂坊」室內絲竹樂團。
「采風樂坊」自1995年起成為文建會
（文化部之前身）國家級扶植團隊，
並為首度進入介壽館
（中華民國總統府2006年前現址館舍正式名稱）
與德國柏林愛樂室內樂廳的國樂團體。
1994年獲中華民國資深青商總會
主辦的「十大傑出青年薪傳獎」（第二屆）。

vocabulary.meaning: To attend school. 在板橋高中就學時 is “while he was at Banqiao Senior High” — the standard way to date an event to somebody's school years.
vocabulary.example: 在板橋高中就學時加入國樂社，

vocabulary.meaning: Graduated from. 於 introduces the institution and cannot be dropped: 畢業 alone says that you graduated, never from where.
vocabulary.example: 大學畢業於中國文化大學音樂系國樂組。

vocabulary.meaning: Chinese traditional orchestral music — the Taiwanese term for it. Mainland writing says 民樂 and Singapore says 華樂 for the same repertoire, so the word alone tells you where a text is from.
vocabulary.example: 與德國柏林愛樂室內樂廳的國樂團體。

vocabulary.meaning: To receive, of an award or a title. Formal and compressed — 獲…獎 does in one character what 得到 needs two for, which is why biographies are full of it.
vocabulary.example: 獲器樂獨奏項目比賽第三獎。

vocabulary.meaning: To nurture or back, of a government supporting an organisation. 國家級扶植團隊 is a specific Taiwanese arts-funding status, not a general compliment.
vocabulary.example: （文化部之前身）國家級扶植團隊，

questions.prompt: Which instrument does the passage say he took up at high school?
options: The piano
The Chinese flute
The erhu
A chamber ensemble of Chinese instruments he co-founded in 1991
The university department he now chairs
An award he received in 1994

questions.prompt: How did he place at the 1983 competition in South Africa?
options: First prize
Second prize
Third prize, in instrumental solo
